description: Source code implementing quantizer-related functions and classes for PyTorch, including creation, quantization, and dequantization of tensors, as well as external dependencies and internal utility functions.

classes.name: PerTensorAffineQuantizer
classes.description: Class representing a per-tensor affine quantizer with methods for quantization and dequantization.

classes.name: PerChannelAffineQuantizer
classes.description: Class representing a per-channel affine quantizer with methods for quantization and dequantization.

classes.name: PerChannelAffineFloatQParamsQuantizer
classes.description: Class for per-channel affine quantizer using floating point q-parameters.

classes.name: UnknownQuantizer
classes.description: Placeholder class for an undefined or unsupported quantizer type.

methods.name: quantizer()
methods.description: Returns the quantizer associated with a tensor.

methods.name: make_per_tensor_affine_quantizer()
methods.description: Creates a per-tensor affine quantizer with specified scale, zero_point, and type.

methods.name: make_per_channel_affine_quantizer()
methods.description: Creates a per-channel affine quantizer with specified scales, zero_points, axis, and type.

methods.name: get_qtensorimpl()
methods.description: Retrieves the internal QTensorImpl from a quantized tensor.

methods.name: set_quantizer_()
methods.description: Sets the quantizer for a tensor.

methods.name: from_blob_quantized_per_tensor_affine()
methods.description: Creates a quantized tensor from raw data blob with per-tensor affine quantization parameters.

methods.name: from_blob_quantized_per_channel_affine()
methods.description: Creates a quantized tensor from raw data blob with per-channel affine quantization parameters.

methods.name: quantize()
methods.description: Quantizes a float tensor into a quantized tensor.

methods.name: dequantize()
methods.description: Dequantizes a quantized tensor back to float.

methods.name: dequantize_out()
methods.description: Dequantizes a quantized tensor into a pre-allocated float tensor.
